product.name: Installment Payment Service
product.description: A service that allows customers to split their purchase invoice into three installments without any additional fees or hidden interests, available for use in entertainment and restaurant sectors.

product.name: MADFU Wallet
product.description: A financial electronic wallet linked to the user's MADFU account, enabling depositing or payment for purchases from participating stores.

product.name: Partnership with Stores
product.description: MADFU collaborates with various stores in the entertainment, restaurant, and beauty sectors, offering a platform for these stores to attract a larger customer base by providing installment payment options.

product.name: Sharia Compliance
product.description: All services provided by MADFU are reviewed by a specialized Sharia committee to ensure compliance with Islamic Sharia controls.

product.name: Customer Support
product.description: MADFU offers customer support through direct chat, email, and a unified phone number for any inquiries or assistance needed.
